create_importance_renderer: create an ImportanceRenderer instance for volume rendering with stratified and importance sampling
build_sample_from_planes: build feature sampling from 2D planes at 3D coordinates using bilinear grid sampling
run_importance_renderer_forward: run the ImportanceRenderer forward pass to compute RGB colors and depth from rays and planes
sample_stratified_along_rays: sample stratified depth points along rays for coarse volume rendering pass
sample_pdf_importance: sample importance-weighted depth points from a PDF for fine volume rendering pass
